newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: KL spot tin ends unchanged despite lower LME.
newsitem.headline: KL spot tin ends unchanged despite lower LME.

text.p: Malaysia's spot tin price ended unchanged at Tuesday's 13.76 ringgit ($5.49) a kg after both sellers and buyers decided to close deals at the opening level, traders said.

"Local tin held relatively steady despite a drop in London price on some buying from Europe and Malaysia," a trader said, expecting prices to hold due to a higher local premium over the London market. The premium was $110 a tonne against Tuesday's $30. Traders said the near-term trend depends on the direction of the ringgit against the U.S. dollar and the London market.
